display.purpose: Landing hero and closing statement; per-letter kinetic entrance.

headline.purpose: Section heads, often two clauses with the second in ink-dim.

body-lead.purpose: Supporting line under a hero, max ~34rem.

label.purpose: Form labels and panel section names; sentence case, ink-dim.

mono.purpose: Timecodes, percentages, keyframe values and counts only.

shadows.name: portrait-lift
shadows.purpose: Under a portrait render centred in a landscape gallery well. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: All entrances, reveals, card preview scale and the keyline draw.

motion.name: letter-in
motion.value: 1s ease-out-expo; translateY(0.9em) rotate(6deg) blur(6px) -> rest; stagger 28ms after 120ms

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveal of sections, only once JS is present.

motion.name: keyline
motion.purpose: Draws the ink line across the keyframe track.

motion.name: card-preview-scale
motion.purpose: Inset preview grows on media-card hover while the render plays.

motion.name: state-colour
motion.purpose: Button, nav and link hover states.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations and transitions to 0.01ms; reveals visible; videos hold poster

components.css: .ds-media { display: block; max-width: 360px; color: #fafafa; text-decoration: none; } .ds-media-frame { padding: 16px; border-radius: 28px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); transition: background-color 300ms; } .ds-media-inner { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; border-radius: 18px; background: #111 linear-gradient(135deg, #f43f5e, #fb7185); transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-media:hover .ds-media-frame { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); } .ds-media:hover .ds-media-inner { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-media:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-media:focus-visible .ds-media-frame { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(250 250 250 / 0.5); } .ds-media-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; margin-top: 12px; padding: 0 4px; } .ds-media-name { font: 500 16px/1.4 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-media-fam { font: 400 12px/1.33 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); color: #8f8f8f; } .ds-media-sum { margin: 4px 0 0; padding: 0 4px; font: 400 14px/1.43 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); color: #8f8f8f; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; height: 64px; padding: 0 32px; background: rgb(10 10 10 / 0.85); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07); font-family: var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-nav-brand { font: 600 17px/1 var(--font-display, Sora, sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #fafafa; } .ds-nav-brand span { color: #8f8f8f; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-link { font-size: 14px; color: #8f8f8f; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: #fafafa; } .ds-nav-spacer { flex: 1; } .ds-nav-ghost, .ds-nav-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-nav-ghost { border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03); color: #fafafa; } .ds-nav-ghost:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); } .ds-nav-cta { background: #fafafa; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(250 250 250 / 0.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Kinetic Headline
components.description: Signature: each letter enters on a staggered keyframe timeline; second line is the grey clause pattern applied to section heads.
components.html: Motion without the timeline.
components.css: @keyframes ds-letter-in { from { transform: translateY(0.9em) rotate(6deg); opacity: 0; filter: blur(6px); } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); } } .ds-kinetic { margin: 0; font: 500 64px/0.96 var(--font-display, Sora, sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.045em; color: #fafafa; } .ds-kinetic > span[style] { display: inline-block; animation: ds-letter-in 1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; animation-delay: calc(var(--i) * 28ms + 120ms); } .ds-dim { color: #8f8f8f; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-kinetic > span[style] { animation: none; } }

components.name: Keyframe Track
components.description: Signature: hairline track with an ink keyline, diamond keyframes and mono timecodes.
components.css: @keyframes ds-keyline { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } } .ds-track { position: relative; padding-top: 0; } .ds-track-line { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 7px; height: 1px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.15); } .ds-track-key { height: 100%; background: #fafafa; transform-origin: 0 50%; animation: ds-keyline 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both 0.5s; } .ds-track-stops { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-track-stops span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-track-stops i { display: block; width: 14px; height: 14px; background: #fafafa; transform: rotate(45deg); box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px #0a0a0a; } .ds-track-stops time { padding: 0 8px; background: #0a0a0a; font: 400 12px/1 var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #8f8f8f; }

narrative.northStar: The Work Is the Only Colour
narrative.overview:
A gallery-first, monochrome stage. The chrome is near-black, off-white and one grey; every chromatic pixel on screen is either the logo mark or the user's own renders and footage. The interface recedes so the motion can lead: big rounded media cards hold real renders autoplaying muted, and the headline itself is the one piece of interface that moves like the product, its letters entering on a staggered keyframe timeline.

Density is generous on the marketing surfaces (1400px container, 128 to 176px between sections, display type up to 6rem) and tighter in the app and free tools, where the same pills, raised fills and grey secondary text carry over at body size. Depth is tonal, not shadowed: surfaces are faint white fills on the black stage, separated by hairlines rather than boxes.

The system refuses the AI-video-tool default of neon gradient glow, glass panels and gradient headline text.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black stage, off-white ink, one secondary grey; no chrome accent colour beyond the logo.
White pill for the primary action, dark hairline pill for everything else.
28px media cards holding an 18px inset preview that scales slightly on hover.
Sora 500 display with tight negative tracking; Geist for interface; Geist Mono only for timecodes and values.
Emphasis by a grey second clause, never by gradient or colour.
Exponential ease-out motion; per-letter headline entrance as the signature.

rules.name: The Work Is the Only Colour Rule
rules.body: No chrome element takes a hue. If something on screen is coloured and it is not the logo mark, it must be the user's render, footage or a format preview.

rules.name: The One Grey Rule
rules.body: Secondary text has one tone (ink-dim). Do not introduce a second grey for tertiary text; use size or weight instead.

rules.name: The Grey Second Clause Rule
rules.body: Emphasis in a heading is made by stepping its second clause back to ink-dim ("Any AI.<grey> Your key or ours.</grey>"). Never gradient text, never a coloured word. The legacy `text-gradient` utility resolves to ink-dim for this reason.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow or kicker labels above headings: no small uppercase tracked line, no category tag sitting over an h1 or h2. The heading opens the section.

rules.name: The Mono Means Numbers Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is reserved for timecodes and values. It is never a decorative label face.

rules.name: The Format's Own Type Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display appears only inside aesthetic-format previews, and Inter and Space Grotesk only as caption-font choices in the tools; they are the work's type, not the chrome's.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur is a legibility tool for sticky bars and small overlays on footage, never a decorative panel material. No frosted cards, no glass hero panels, no glow.

dos: Do let real renders carry the colour: autoplay them muted in 28px media cards with an 18px inset preview.
Do make emphasis with a grey second clause in ink-dim.
Do use the white pill for the one primary action per view and dark hairline pills for the rest.
Do set display and headlines in Sora 500 with negative tracking (-0.035em to -0.045em) and balanced wrapping.
Do use Geist Mono with tabular figures for timecodes, percentages and keyframe values.
Do move on the exponential ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) and honour reduced motion.
Do show a format as a typographic poster only when its look is set in type; formats whose look depends on footage appear once a real render exists.
donts: Don't add colour to the chrome; the logo mark is the only brand colour.
Don't use gradient text, neon glow or gradient backgrounds in the interface.
Don't put eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.
Don't use glass or backdrop blur as decoration; it is reserved for sticky bars and small overlays on footage.
Don't use mono as a label or decorative face.
Don't put borders on media cards or wrap sections in boxes; use raised fills and hairlines.
Don't show stand-in imagery for formats whose look depends on footage.
